title: Unit 4 Consolidation: the conquest
goal: Review the conquest of Mexico and Peru, the allies and the peoples who resisted, the abuses and the laws, and how historians judge the conquest.

items: Talk about the conquest of Mexico and Peru with the passive, the pluperfect, the gerund, the subjunctive after requests and *creer que*.
Put the main events of the conquest of Mexico in order.
Name the allies of Cortés and the peoples who resisted.
Use the words of the unit: ransom, friar, legend, defeat and besiege.
Say how historians judge the conquest and the Black Legend.
